owns: legacy/shared shell compatibility and global type/chrome
authorities.future_direction: shrink after M0 as ownership moves into explicit primitives
split only when component/controller split occurs
do not copy its !important-heavy pattern into new Kona.m features

rules: One shared selector should have one clear owner unless a documented responsive/theme override requires another.
Feature CSS may position shared components but should not redefine their base visual contract.
No new raw brand palette values in feature CSS when a semantic token exists.
No new !important without a comment explaining the compatibility boundary.
Mobile safe-area handling belongs to shell/layout authorities, not scattered feature patches.
CSS cleanup must prove identical phone portrait, short-landscape, desktop and desktop-view-phone behavior.
m0: Preserve current CSS files and load order exactly.
post_m0_sequence: choose owner for each shared selector
remove redundant overrides one cluster at a time
